reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes Forsage's matrix as a way to earn extraordinary daily amounts, claiming personal earnings of 83 BUSD and 5.737 BNB and stating that people can earn up to one crore per day. He presents a team-and-partner dashboard and repeatedly displays a joining contact number, directly encouraging viewers to participate in the matrix opportunity. The combination of extreme income claims, matrix-based participation and a joining call to action supports a recruitment-oriented deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: Forsage's new matrix X-Core has been added in Forsage.
From the morning till now, I have earned 83 BUSD and 5.737 BNB from the system so far.
This power is only for sage that he can give 1 lakh, 2 lakh, 3 lakh, 5 lakhs, 10 lakhs, 20 lakhs, 1 crore per day.

opening.argument: The speaker presents reported figures and personal experience, but the supplied material does not include a guarantee, risk-free promise, or assurance that viewers will achieve the same result. The income language is framed around what he says he earned and what he claims others have earned, rather than a formal certification of returns. A careful viewer would still need to verify the figures and assess the risks independently; the evidence provided does not establish that the opportunity is safe, guaranteed, or suitable for everyone.

citations.quote: From the morning till now, I have earned 83 BUSD and 5.737 BNB from the system so far.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the income statements as proof of deceptive solicitation, but the quoted material establishes only what the speaker says about earnings. It does not establish that the figures are guaranteed, that viewers were promised identical results, or that participation necessarily requires a particular payment. The visible contact information shows a way to communicate, but by itself does not prove deception or a guaranteed return.

citations.quote: If you want to earn 6000 per day,

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The speaker does more than neutrally report an unverifiable personal result: he describes Forsage's matrix and presents unusually large daily earning possibilities, including one crore per day. The absence of an explicit word such as “guaranteed” does not neutralize a solicitation built around extraordinary earnings, especially when the video supplies a joining contact. The claims remain promotional and unsupported by independent verification.

citations.quote: This power is only for sage that he can give 1 lakh, 2 lakh, 3 lakh, 5 lakhs, 10 lakhs, 20 lakhs, 1 crore per day.
Forsage's new matrix X-Core has been added in Forsage.

opening.argument: The video can be read as an operational demonstration of a digital earning system. The speaker identifies the system's new matrix and points viewers to a live ID and displayed earnings, giving an example of how the interface records activity. That is consistent with explaining or demonstrating a platform and sharing personal experience, not necessarily proving that the creator is making a deceptive solicitation. The supplied material does not show a scripted enrollment procedure, instructions to recruit a downline, or a demonstration that viewers will receive returns.

citations.quote: Forsage's new matrix X-Core has been added in Forsage.
the live ID has been shared in front of you.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the presentation a demonstration does not make it a recruitment scheme. The prosecution's quotations show that the speaker discussed a matrix and earnings, but they do not show that the video instructs viewers to recruit others, pay money, or rely on a guaranteed outcome. A platform walkthrough can include a personal result without becoming proof of fraud.

citations.quote: the live ID has been shared in front of you.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The dashboard is not presented as neutral software training. It is paired with claims that Forsage can produce escalating daily amounts and with repeated joining contact information. The reference evidence therefore concerns the function of the demonstration in context: it uses a displayed account and matrix structure to make participation appear financially attractive, rather than merely explaining interface mechanics.

citations.quote: This power is only for sage that he can give 1 lakh, 2 lakh, 3 lakh, 5 lakhs, 10 lakhs, 20 lakhs, 1 crore per day.

opening.argument: The supplied evidence does not establish the core mechanics of a scam. It does not show a deposit request, a guaranteed return, a demand for credentials, or a stated requirement that viewers recruit a downline. The visible contact text identifies a joining contact, but a contact point alone does not establish what transaction, if any, would follow. The video may therefore be ordinary promotion or referral-style communication about a digital service, with the speaker describing his own claimed activity rather than proving an unlawful mechanism.

citations.quote: the morning till now, the live ID has been shared in front of you
If you want to earn 6000 per day,

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution infers a complete recruitment mechanism from the word “matrix,” dashboard labels, and a contact overlay. Those elements may indicate an opportunity, but the supplied record does not identify a payment amount, a required deposit, a promised commission for recruiting, or credentials being requested. The evidence supports promotion at most; it does not itself prove the missing transaction mechanics.

citations.quote: Forsage's new matrix X-Core has been added in Forsage.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The mechanism need not be fully verbalized to be evident from the combined presentation. The speaker links participation in Forsage's matrix to earnings, displays separate partner and team information, and places joining contact information on screen. His claim that the system can generate progressively larger daily sums makes the contact overlay function as an invitation to enter that structure, not merely an unrelated customer-service detail.
